headline: As of 2026-10-15: 5,485,017 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 37 of 50 states, D+21.7 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 5,485,017 early/mail ballots cast so far across 37 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+21.7 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Florida (669,830), California (594,007), Michigan (573,306).
